//: The ts-drizzle-postgres pack (ADR 2026-063, ADR 2026-058, ADR 2026-064): Postgres persistence through Drizzle, one Postgres schema per context. It contributes the `drizzle` storage adapter technology (pins go to every context workspace whose tree has adapters/out/drizzle), the generated files each context with a store gets (drizzle.config.ts, drizzle-database.ts, schema/<context>.schema.ts, the Testcontainers test support; migrations come only from the generate_artifacts gate), the root docker-compose.yml and .env.example as generated config, the shipped check-db and db-migrate scripts, and ignores the root .env. Each context's drizzle.config.ts names its own migrations table, so contexts sharing one database never read each other's history; that is the one line it adds to the worked example's config.

adapterTechnologies.description: Postgres through Drizzle ORM: one store per feature, sharing the context's DrizzleDatabase (Drizzle's generic Postgres database type, never a driver), tested against real Postgres with Testcontainers.

//projectInitScripts: Explicitly none: this pack has nothing to scaffold at bounded init. Its root config ships as projectConfigFiles and everything else is generated from the design.
